claims.claim: You must contact an approved debt adviser to apply for a DRO
claims.quote: You have to contact an approved debt adviser to apply for a DRO .
claims.note: The guidance expressly requires contact with an approved adviser.

claims.claim: The approved debt adviser submits the DRO application for you
claims.quote: If you are eligible, the debt adviser will complete an online application for you and submit it to the Insolvency Service.
claims.note: The adviser completes and submits the online application; the applicant cannot apply alone.
